card.name: Adverse events 'have occurred' in warnings
card.fires_on: The verb right after 'have' or 'have been' in warning statements, mostly 'occurred' or 'reported'. It also fires on 'reported' or 'ED' in 'cases have been reported' sentences about serious or fatal events.

modes.label: Fatal cases have occurred
modes.description: The word 'occurred' after 'have' in boxed-warning style sentences about life-threatening or fatal events.
modes.example: Life-threatening and fatal meningococcal infections have<< occurred>> in patients treated with complement inhibitors.

modes.label: Cases have been reported
modes.description: The word 'reported' (or 'REPORT' + 'ED') in post-marketing style sentences.
modes.example: Cases of TSS have been<< reported>> by ANNOVERA users.

card.plain: It marks the spot in a warning where the text says that serious harms have occurred or been reported.
